definitions.gloss: to dry one's hair; to blow-dry one's hair
definitions.explanation: The standard collocation for drying wet hair after a bath or shower. The verb {乾|かわ}かす is the causative 'to make dry,' and is used for any object that is actively dried (hair, laundry, etc.), as opposed to things that dry passively.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドライヤー→ドライヤー：05076_doraiyaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髪|かみ}を{乾|かわ}かした。
examples.english: I dried my hair with a hair dryer.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{髪|かみ}を{乾|かわ}かした⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should dry your hair right away after getting out of the bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{十分以上|じゅっぷんいじょう}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: My hair is long, so it takes more than ten minutes to dry.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ ('hair [of the head]') + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧ ('to dry [something]'). Note the transitive/intransitive pair: ⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ means 'to become dry,' ⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧ means 'to make something dry' — the latter takes a direct object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

USAGE:
- Covers drying with a towel, a hair dryer, or simply by letting time pass; the means can be specified with で (e.g., ⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧, ⟦ドライヤー→ドライヤー：05076_doraiyaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧).
- Does not inherently imply styling — for that, ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧スタイリング⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ are used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ドライヤー→ドライヤー：05076_doraiyaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髪|かみ}を{乾|かわ}かす: blow-dry one's hair with a hair dryer
- ⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髪|かみ}を{乾|かわ}かす: towel-dry one's hair
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{髪|かみ}を{乾|かわ}かす: let one's hair air-dry
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧: dry one's hair thoroughly

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash one's hair
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦とかす→とかす：28246_tokasu⟧: to comb one's hair
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut one's hair / get a haircut
- ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧: to dry laundry — same verb used for other objects

TRANSITIVITY:
- ⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧ is transitive (requires an object + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧).
- ⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ is the intransitive pair: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}いた→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ ('my hair has dried').
- Learners sometimes mistakenly say ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧; the correct transitive form is ⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧.
